✦ RESONANT ARCANA — 1.1.0 ✦

Call down a storm. Drag down the moon. Pass judgement from above.

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge · Java 21

The God Incarnations update brings a new ultimate spell, native boss forms and battlefield-scale effects to Resonant Arcana, alongside refreshed icons and brighter grimoires.

🔊 Warden’s Judgement

A new Eldritch God spell joins the collection, bringing the total to 21 God-tier spells.

  • Gather a giant echo charge above the marked ground, then send a massive sonic boom crashing down.
  • The impact deals heavy sonic damage and applies Deafened for eight seconds, muffling affected players’ hearing and slowing movement and attacks.

🌩️ God magic, rebuilt

  • Thunder of the Heavens: a massive storm canopy, driving rain and 200 branching lightning strikes.
  • Crimson Apotheosis: drifting crimson petals, native blood particles and flowing siphon trails.
  • Solar Supernova: a giant square Minecraft sun builds toward a devastating fire blast.
  • Absolute Glaciation: a thick snowstorm filled with driving snow, frost and freezing impacts.
  • Verdant Awakening: a giant spotted rafflesia blooms over the battlefield, spreading poisonous pollen while supporting allies.
  • Soul Ascendancy: rising soul-fire, sculk spirits and flowing ascension trails.
  • Primordial Sovereign: native dinosaur spirits, Iron’s fireflies and a living field of spores and primal dust.
  • Planetary Polarity: vast magnetic flows pull enemies inward before dragging a giant moon down onto the mark.
  • Forsaken Eclipse: a sun and moon collide, dealing massive damage and inflicting Blindness and Darkness.
  • Abyssal World Tide: travelling native waves, breaking foam, spray and a powerful undertow.
  • Confection Apocalypse: actual Alex’s Caves peppermint models, falling gumballs, sugar and candy fragments.

🐉 Native boss power

  • Tremorzilla Cataclysm: manifests a giant native Tremorzilla head, complete with its charge sounds and purple breath attack.
  • Kraken’s World Drown: eight invincible native tentacles rise together, face inward and slam enemies with drowning damage.
  • Yeti’s World Heart: summons the native Yeti’s form for heavy ground slams, snow bursts and freezing attacks.
  • Sandworm’s World Devourer: a giant invincible sandworm emerges at the centre and unleashes four expanding sand shockwaves.
  • Dragon’s Primordial Inferno: grants animated native dragon wings and temporary flight, followed by a huge aimed fireblast with burning and knockback. Slow Falling helps with the landing.
  • Helvar’s Final Edict: blue and purple fractures, spectral sparks and a forceful sword impact.

✨ Effects with impact

  • Expanded vanilla and Iron’s Spellbooks particle choreography, with distinct native effects across all 21 God spells.
  • Aligned major damage hits with their visible collisions and strengthened impact bursts.
  • Rebuilt Doom Beam as an emerald particle stream, removing its beacon beam and solid black charge orb.
  • Added a small layer of vanilla glints to Rho Aias.
  • Removed generic AA seals from God-tier spells and Doom Beam.

🎨 Matching icons & brighter books

  • Recoloured all 228 spell icons to match their school or spell theme, including the new Warden spell and Helvar’s blue-purple palette.
  • Preserved the supplied pixel artwork, shapes and transparency.
  • Fixed inventory lighting on all nine grimoires, keeping their original inventory artwork and 3D models.

🛡️ Combat & compatibility

  • Boss apparitions are invincible spell visuals; their normal boss AI and destructive attacks do not run.
  • Damage respects ally protection and solid cover, while spells preserve terrain.
  • Bosses’Rise and Alex’s Caves remain optional integrations.

Install this 1.1.0 build on both client and server.
